tools.name: Windows Range
tools.tagline: Harden the workstation. Then the server.
tools.description: A Windows 11 and Windows Server 2025 hardening lab in your browser: sign in, read the scenario brief, answer the investigation questions, then fix it with the real panels or the command line while a live Progress Check keeps count.

tools.name: Linux Range
tools.tagline: Harden the box from the shell.
tools.description: Ubuntu, Linux Mint, and Ubuntu Server hardening labs in your browser: a real-feeling bash terminal with sudo, apt, systemctl, ufw, PAM, cron, and nano, three scenarios, and a live Progress Check with availability checks.

tools.name: Cisco Range
tools.tagline: Secure the topology. Prove it with ping.
tools.description: A Packet Tracer-style topology in your browser: IOS consoles with ? help, abbreviations, and the exact error messages, PC command prompts, four scenarios from one router to a two-site network with VLAN trunks, router-on-a-stick, and OSPF, and a live Progress Check.
